document.abstract: The primary goal of any television news production team is to deliver an audio/visual narrative that engages the audience. Often this is accomplished under ideal conditions of time and environment. But just as often this must be accomplished as a live news event is underway or in a challenging physical and Radio Frequency (RF) environment.
